main_text.l: CHARACTE-RVM IESVITI-CORVM CENTVRIA SECVNDA.
I. CHARACTER.
NVNQVAM in sermone adulationis
fuimus, sicut nouistis, inquit Apostolus;
neque in pretextu auaritiæ, neque
quærentes gloriam ab hominibus, neque à
vobis, neque ab aliis, cùm possemus esse one-
ri vt Christi Apostoli: sed fuimus manuetci [?]
in medio vestri, sicut nutrix fouet filios suos. Ea-
dem ratione eis qui sunt diuinorum verborum
participes obseruandum est, num nimium cu-
riosi animi vitio inducti, tanquam vrbium
[?] ædificia visuri, ad id accedant, num veniant vt
fiant rerum particularium participes [quod
Iesuitae sedulo faciunt] cùm audierint eos qui sunt
Christo consecrati ea, quæ sunt ad victum
necessaria, libenter communicare. At sunt ii
quidem hypocritæ, ideo mittantur. Clemens
II.
Quidam [Iesuitæ] seipsos erigentes, calum-
nias verbis inuenire contendunt, contentiolas

page.notes: The ornament above the title is a typographic device, not text. The drop capital N is joined to "VNQVAM" as printed. Doubtful readings: "manuetci" (possibly another reading of the word) and "vrbium" (read as "verbium" in the scan; the context suggests urbium). The line "nias verbis inuenire contendunt" continues from "calum-" at the line end; the last line "contentiolas" ends the text and is not a catchword, since the page continues with the printed text above the signature.
